detail.lead: KT board for mounting indoor display graphics, exhibition boards and indoor signage. We supply finished panels — your graphic printed, mounted and trimmed — rather than blank board alone. 5mm is the standard thickness; full sheets are 900×2400mm and 1200×2400mm (maximum sizes, cut to your dimensions). 10mm board is currently produced only at our partner factory in Haiyan, Zhejiang, for the Jiangsu-Zhejiang-Shanghai-Anhui region.
